name: okrapdf
description: Parse PDFs on your own computer: an offline MCP server with page-and-box citations for every block, a local dashboard with hover source mapping, local models, your own API keys, and ParseBench scoring.

interface.shortDescription: Parse PDFs offline, with page-and-box citations
interface.longDescription: Parse a PDF on your own computer and open it in the okraPDF viewer: each page with its blocks drawn on it. Click a block to attach it to the chat with its page and box, so each answer cites its source. Open any PDF in a thread with Open in → okraPDF, or add an okraPDF tab beside the thread. The text layer is free and offline; local models (Ollama, LM Studio) and your own API keys handle scans. No account.
defaultPrompt: Open this PDF in the okraPDF viewer
Find the total revenue in this PDF and cite the page
Parse this PDF and show me the tables
